editorialSummary.heading: Homecoming, holiday breaks and HCHS graduation
highlights: October 9: homecoming and early dismissal; October 12: no classes
Students return January 6 after Christmas Holidays and two staff days
Spring Break is March 29–April 2, with March 25–26 also off for students
paragraphs: Hamilton County Elementary serves Pre-K through fifth grade, while Hamilton County High serves grades 6–12, including middle school students. The first student day is August 10, 2026. Meet the Teacher is August 6, although the 4–7 p.m. hours listed in the HCHS senior calendar should not be assumed for every grade or campus. On October 9, homecoming and the end of the first quarter fall on the same day. Students then have Monday, October 12 off for a teacher workday.

Two professional-learning days extend holiday weekends for students: September 8 follows Labor Day, and February 16 follows Presidents' Day. Thanksgiving Holidays run November 23–27. Christmas Holidays are December 21–31, but students don't return until January 6 because New Year's Day and the January 4–5 staff days follow the holiday break.

Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, 2027. Students are also off March 25 for a teacher workday and March 26 for Good Friday. Counting the weekends, this gives them 11 consecutive days without regular classes, March 25–April 4. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, April 5.

At HCHS, Baccalaureate is scheduled for May 20 at 7 p.m. in the auditorium, followed by graduation on May 21 at 8 p.m. at Veteran's Memorial Stadium. Seniors have separate rehearsal and reporting times, which should not be confused with districtwide dismissal times. May 21 is also the last student day. The annual calendar gives no fixed date for final report-card distribution.

The seven early-dismissal school days are October 9, November 20 and December 17–18, 2026, and March 24 and May 20–21, 2027. These shortened schedules apply to district students; the HCHS evening ceremonies have separate reporting times for graduates. The annual calendar does not give dismissal clock times, so check your school for pickup and bus arrangements.

about.dataSource: The district’s two-page 2026-2027 calendar linked from its Events Calendar page, supplemented by the HCHS Class of 2027 page, senior calendar and graduation plan for school-specific visiting and ceremony arrangements. The local district calendar and current official download have matching SHA-256 hashes. The PDF prints HCSB approval on April 14, 2026.
about.processing: Both district PDF pages were visually reviewed alongside extracted text. Published dates, crossed-out staff days and the page-2 Non-Student Days list establish the no-class schedule. August 10 is the first day, not an early dismissal; the asterisk alone is not a schedule label. The seven explicitly listed early-dismissal dates remain attendance days. October 9, December 18, May 20 and May 21 each have one canonical occurrence with all applicable classifications. March 19 is a regular quarter-end day, not an early dismissal. March 29-April 2 is an explicitly continuous Spring Break on page 2 and across the March/April grid; keep March 25 workday and March 26 Good Friday separate. Christmas Holidays end December 31; January 1 and January 4-5 remain distinct closures and January 6 is an explicit return. The page-2 Holidays list says December 21-31, 2025, but the December 2026 grid and Non-Student Days list both specify 2026; those two consistent entries determine the event year. The May cumulative figure and four quarter counts give 174 student days, matching 205 weekdays minus 31 confirmed closures. Employee workday bullets instead use 175 student days. No missing attendance date is invented to reconcile that inconsistency. The annual statistic uses the printed 174 with an explicit source-conflict note. No daily attendance date remains ambiguous from this numerical mismatch. No final report-card event is assigned a guessed date. July/August preplanning, the August 4 staff welcome/health fair, May postplanning, the summer four-day employee week and Memorial Day after the last student day are omitted. The HCHS senior calendar is a source for HCHS visiting hours only, not an elementary bell schedule or districtwide additional attendance. Older elementary home-page hours appear under a 2025-2026 banner and were not adopted as current. PDF creation/modification metadata is not a printed revision date.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Hamilton County, Florida, in 2026?
faqs.answer: Monday, August 10, 2026 is the first student day on the Hamilton County School District 2026–2027 calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Hamilton County, FL?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 21, 2027 is the last student day. It is an early-dismissal day and also marks the end of the fourth quarter. HCHS graduation is scheduled for that evening.

faqs.question: Which Hamilton County schools and grades follow this calendar?
faqs.answer: The regular district calendar covers Hamilton County Elementary, which serves Pre-K through fifth grade, and Hamilton County High, which serves grades 6–12, including middle school students. Both schools are in Jasper, Florida. Virtual-school, adult-education and other separate program schedules should be confirmed directly with those programs.

faqs.question: When is Meet the Teacher in 2026?
faqs.answer: Meet the Teacher is Thursday, August 6, 2026. The HCHS senior calendar lists 4–7 p.m., with senior schedule pickup in the cafeteria. The district calendar does not specify visiting hours for every school or grade, so families should confirm their school's arrangements.

faqs.question: Is there school the Tuesday after Labor Day?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day and Tuesday, September 8 for a staff professional-learning day. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, September 9, giving students a four-day weekend.

faqs.question: When is homecoming in Hamilton County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Homecoming is Friday, October 9, 2026. The district calendar also marks that day for early dismissal and the end of the first quarter. Monday, October 12 is a teacher workday with no student classes, and students are scheduled to return Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Is there a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: No October fall-break week is scheduled on the Florida district's 2026–2027 calendar. Students have Monday, October 12 off for a teacher workday, following the October 9 homecoming early dismissal. HCHS calls November 23–27 Fall Break, while the district calendar calls that week Thanksgiving Holidays.

faqs.question: Are Hamilton County schools closed for Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is a student holiday for Veterans Day. No regular student classes are scheduled.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Holidays run Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students have early dismissal on Friday, November 20 and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. Including weekends, students are off November 21–29.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Hamilton County schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar calls December 21–31, 2026 Christmas Holidays. New Year's Day on January 1 and staff days on January 4–5 mean students remain out of class through January 5. Including weekends, the continuous winter time off runs December 19–January 5, with students returning Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When do Hamilton County students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a teacher workday, and Tuesday, January 5 is a professional-learning and data day. Neither is a regular student attendance day.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027 is a school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Students have no regular classes.

faqs.question: Are students off the day after Presidents' Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027 is the Presidents' Day holiday, and Tuesday, February 16 is a professional-learning day without regular student classes. Students have a four-day weekend, February 13–16, and are scheduled to return Wednesday, February 17.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Hamilton County, Florida, in 2027?
faqs.answer: The official Spring Break is Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students are also off Thursday, March 25 for a teacher workday and Friday, March 26 for Good Friday. Including weekends, there are 11 consecutive days without regular classes, March 25–April 4. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, April 5.

faqs.question: When do Hamilton County students return after spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, April 5, 2027. The official Spring Break ends Friday, April 2, followed by the weekend. Students also have March 25–26 off before the break begins.

faqs.question: Do Hamilton County students have Good Friday off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a full student holiday for Good Friday. Thursday, March 25 is also student-free because of a teacher workday. These dates are separate from the officially named March 29–April 2 Spring Break.

faqs.question: Which days have early dismissal in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Early dismissal is scheduled for October 9, November 20, December 17 and 18, 2026, and March 24, May 20 and 21, 2027. All seven are school days with shortened schedules, not full days off. The district calendar does not specify dismissal times.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal at Hamilton County schools?
faqs.answer: The district's annual 2026–2027 calendar lists early-dismissal dates but does not publish dismissal clock times. Check Hamilton County Elementary or Hamilton County High for the applicable release time, bus schedule and pickup arrangements.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-learning days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: The six in-year student-free staff days are September 8 and October 12, 2026, and January 4, January 5, February 16 and March 25, 2027. October 12, January 4 and March 25 are teacher workdays. The other three are professional-learning days, with January 5 also designated for data work.

faqs.question: When do the quarters and semesters end?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 9, 2026; Quarter 2 ends December 18, 2026; Quarter 3 ends March 19, 2027; and Quarter 4 ends May 21, 2027. The first semester ends December 18 and the second ends May 21. October 9, December 18 and May 21 have early dismissal; March 19 does not.

faqs.question: When are student progress reports distributed?
faqs.answer: The district schedules progress reports for September 10 and November 12, 2026, and February 11 and April 22, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent out in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Grade reports are scheduled for October 15, 2026, January 7, 2027 and April 8, 2027. The official calendar says school offices are responsible for distributing final report cards, but it does not give a specific year-end distribution date.

faqs.question: When is HCHS Baccalaureate in 2027?
faqs.answer: Hamilton County High's Baccalaureate is Thursday, May 20, 2027 at 7 p.m. in the HCHS auditorium. Graduates are instructed to report to the media center at 6:15 p.m. for lineup.

faqs.question: When and where is Hamilton County High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: HCHS graduation is scheduled for Friday, May 21, 2027 at 8 p.m. at Veteran's Memorial Stadium at Hamilton County High in Jasper. Graduates must report to the school gym at 6:15 p.m. for lineup.

faqs.question: When is the HCHS Class of 2027 cap and gown order deadline?
faqs.answer: Friday, January 29, 2027 is the deadline to order caps and gowns through Herff Jones. HCHS requires graduates to purchase their caps and gowns from Herff Jones to participate in graduation. Distribution is scheduled for Senior Clearance on Friday, May 14. Check the HCHS Class of 2027 page for ordering instructions.

faqs.question: When are the HCHS Grad Walk and Baccalaureate practice?
faqs.answer: Both are scheduled for Wednesday, May 19, 2027. The Grad Walk begins at 8 a.m., with graduates reporting to the HCHS auditorium first. The scheduled walk goes from Hamilton County Elementary to Hamilton County High. Baccalaureate practice follows in the HCHS auditorium; the senior calendar lists it for 9 a.m.

faqs.question: Is graduation practice mandatory for HCHS seniors?
faqs.answer: Yes. Graduation practice is scheduled for Friday, May 21, 2027 at 8 a.m. at the HCHS stadium. The school graduation plan states that seniors who do not participate in practice will not be allowed to walk in the graduation ceremony.

faqs.question: What happens if bad weather affects HCHS graduation?
faqs.answer: If graduation cannot safely take place at the stadium on Friday evening, the HCHS plan moves the ceremony to Saturday, May 22, 2027 at 10 a.m. If the stadium is still unsafe, the gym is the next alternative. The superintendent makes the decision, and families will be notified. May 22 is a ceremony backup date, not an additional regular school day.

faqs.question: How do tickets work if HCHS graduation moves indoors?
faqs.answer: If weather forces graduation into the HCHS gym, each graduate will receive 10 weather tickets at graduation practice, including two priority red tickets. Ticket holders can enter through the rear gym entrance starting at 8:45 a.m. General admission without a ticket begins at the front entrance at 9:45 a.m., subject to gym capacity. These arrangements apply only if the ceremony moves to the gym.

faqs.question: How many school days are in the 2026–2027 Hamilton County calendar?
faqs.answer: The dated district calendar supports 174 student days. Its four quarter totals are 43, 43, 50 and 38 days, adding up to 174. However, employee-workday notes on the second PDF page refer to 175 student days. The published student dates support 174, and the discrepancy does not establish an additional class day.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2026–2027 Hamilton County school calendar?
faqs.answer: The district's Events Calendar page at https://hamiltonfl.com/28148 links the official two-page 2026–2027 District Calendar PDF. The document shows Hamilton County School Board approval dated April 14, 2026.

faqs.question: Does the calendar include weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The published 2026–2027 district calendar does not designate specific weather make-up days. Check Hamilton County School District announcements and ParentSquare for any later changes to school operations or attendance dates.
